messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Timing
parts:
I just added timing to our model tests. If you run "make test-models", this will generate a file in models/timing.csv that writes out:
- model
- # chains
- # samples (kept, across the chains)
- # parameters
- time (ms)
- n effective: min, max, mean, median
- time per n effective: min, max, mean, median

Is there anything else we want to capture?


If you want to see the output file for the last Jenkins run, see:
http://d1m1s1b1.stat.columbia.edu:8080/job/Stan%20Model%20Tests/ws/models/timing.csv



Daniel
